gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps
gsettings get org.gnome.shell enabled-extensions
gsettings get org.gnome.shell disabled-extensions

Mluva migration backup: $BACKUP

gsettings get org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.media-keys.custom-keybinding:/test/legacy/ command

systemctl list-units --all --plain --no-legend voice-scribe-input@*.service
sudo -v
update-desktop-database $CASE/home/.local/share/applications

sudo systemctl daemon-reload
